title: China's First Bank Sat Inside This 6-km Ming Wall — Pingyao | 平遥古城
description:
A 6-km wall you can walk in one loop, 72 watchtowers — and on one street inside, China's very first bank.

Pingyao's wall was built around 1370 and has barely changed since; inside it sits a living Ming-Qing county town, not a rebuilt film set. In 1823, the Rishengchang draft bank (日升昌) opened here — the birthplace of modern Chinese banking, which at its peak moved close to half of China's silver across the empire. UNESCO listed the whole city in 1997.

🧭 Expert Tip: Walk the full wall loop right at opening, before the tour buses arrive — the dawn light on the watchtowers is the shot, and you'll have the ramparts nearly to yourself.

六公里城墙、72座敌楼，城里一条街上藏着中国第一家银行——平遥，一座活着的明清城。
